label: 19 · Error Mosaic
description: Failing on-canvas, usefully: collect EVERY problem with a remedy, then return makeErrorMosaic — a renderable report card instead of a dead preview. Three deliberately breakable knobs to practice on.

ratio.label: Ratio
ratio.description: Split ratio for the card (0.1-0.9). Try 5 to break it.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent color as #rrggbb. Try "orange" to break it.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Comma-separated tags, 1-4 items of 1-8 ASCII chars. Try five items.
